_comment: The Sintering Kiln (#248). Brick rather than steel, and that is the point of the machine:
sintering holds a compact BELOW its melting point, so the shell does not have to survive a
melt the way the Slag Furnace's does. A kiln is refractory lining, not a crucible.
It still costs a Bulb, because holding a soak temperature means watching one - and the Bulb is
a component the depths and the household stream both supply.
Cost belongs to the balance pass (#36); the shape belongs here.
